verdicts.name: Sea Box, Cinnaminson NJ
verdicts.reason: Real miss: ISO container modifier with a stated battery-storage enclosure line ("Batteries in a box") and onboard-generator builds; boundary rule 4. Welders on staff. Record p-sea-box-cinnaminson-nj.

verdicts.name: Fidelity Manufacturing, Waco TX
verdicts.reason: Same plant. Manufacturing Today (June 2026) calls the first regional plant "a 200,000-square-foot site in Waco"; the ledger's McGregor record (menafn release: McGregor, 200,000 sq ft, ~450 jobs; TDLR: 2055 S Main St Unit 2, McGregor) is the first Texas plant in McLennan County (48309). No second Waco address found. Supplementary evidence rows added to the existing id.

verdicts.name: Panel Built, Blue Ridge GA
verdicts.reason: Blue Ridge (1506 Ballewtown Rd, ~70,000 sq ft "Wall Panel/Prefab Facility" on the current contact page) is a different site from Blairsville (193 Mauney Rd), but the only link to aluminum generator enclosures and sub-base tanks is a 2018 release saying the line "will be manufactured" in Blue Ridge. No current panelbuilt.com page lists a generator enclosure or power-products line (sitemap and site pages checked). Lead only; no record.

verdicts.name: Yancey Engineered Solutions, Griffin GA
verdicts.reason: Real miss: Griffin factory is the division's established enclosure, fuel tank and testing plant ("Manufactured by Yancey Engineered Solutions in Griffin, GA"); EPA ECHO lists 96 Etheridge Mill Industrial Park. Aluminum-heavy; welding at Griffin inferred. Record p-yancey-griffin-ga (coordinates road-level).

verdicts.name: Yancey Engineered Solutions, Cordele GA
verdicts.reason: Announcement only (governor's release 2026-06-25: $5.7M to refurbish the former Big Tex plant at 502 S Midway Rd, Cordele, 300 jobs, plans to hire welders). The building exists but the sources say it "will" be refurbished; no source shows fit-out under way or production, and no Cordele Yancey posting could be retrieved. Rule 6: no record. Lead address 502 S Midway Rd, Cordele, GA 31015 (Census 31.9644,-83.7459, Crisp 13081).

verdicts.name: Yancey Engineered Solutions, Batesville MS
verdicts.reason: Real miss: former Crown Cork and Seal building at 195 Crown Dr (MDEQ permit record); Yancey is hiring Batesville welders (MIG, fuel tanks, aluminum stud frames). Status row: building exists and is being staffed; production start not confirmed. Record p-yancey-batesville-ms.

verdicts.name: Martin Energy Group, Tipton MO
verdicts.reason: Real miss: HQ and manufacturing base at 70150 US Hwy 50; states custom sound-attenuated enclosures for generator and CHP packages. Welding stated at Tipton only for piping; enclosure welding at Tipton is inferred, so the record is provisional. Record p-martin-energy-tipton-mo (coordinates approximate).

verdicts.name: Power Pool Plus, Greenwood SC
verdicts.reason: Real miss: 1107 Willard Rd plant (SC governor release 2020; company contact page); stated custom walk-in generator enclosures (14 ga galvanneal steel) and fuel tanks plus reefer gensets. Thin-sheet weak fit noted. Record p-power-pool-plus-greenwood-sc.

verdicts.name: Epic Power Solutions, Ocala FL
verdicts.reason: epicpowerfl.com returns 502 or an empty shell (only a "Page Not Found" template with the Epic Power name); EGSA buying-guide page not retrievable; web search finds no source for the company. No address or product statement could be quoted.

verdicts.name: Hennig Rockford Division (formerly AME), Rockford IL
verdicts.reason: hennigworldwide.com footer lists "Hennig Rockford Division (formerly AME), 2500 Latham Street, Rockford, IL 61103" (a different address from the ledger's Machesney Park record), but AME is described by The Fabricator (2024) as a machine-tool components sister company; the enclosure-fabrication statements for Rockford come from a 2008 release about an older building. The Hennig Paylocity board lists welder roles only under "Hennig Power". No current evidence that Rockford fabricates enclosures. Lead only.

verdicts.name: Com-Fab Inc., Plain City OH
verdicts.reason: Real miss, weakly sourced: EPA ECHO confirms the facility at 4657 Price Hilliard Rd; product claim (sub-base tanks, trailers, enclosures) comes only from a MapQuest directory page; company website does not resolve. Record p-com-fab-plain-city-oh with tier unknown.

verdicts.name: HOLT Manufacturing, Waco TX
verdicts.reason: Real miss: 100,000 sq ft fabrication facility on the HOLT Texas Central Campus (2000 Texas Central Pkwy per EPA ECHO) states "enclosures for generator packages", oilfield engine skids and in-house welding. Record p-holt-waco-tx; separate from Fidelity (McGregor).

verdicts.name: Taylor Power Systems, Richland MS
verdicts.reason: Separate site from Clinton: powerprogress.com says the sound-attenuated enclosure is "manufactured at Taylor’s fabrication facility in Richland, Miss." and a Taylor posting says it operates a metal fabrication shop in Richland. Street address of the shop not confirmed (four ECHO registrations in Richland); coordinates approximate. Record p-taylor-power-richland-ms.

verdicts.name: Stateline Power Corp., Greenville OH
verdicts.reason: Real miss, boundary: 45,000 sq ft generator plant with in-house metal fabrication; all-aluminum thin-sheet enclosures (0.063 in and 0.13 in). Aluminum-first and weak fit; welding inferred. Record p-stateline-power-greenville-oh.

verdicts.name: Harvard Integrations, Tea SD
verdicts.reason: Real miss: generator enclosures and sub-base fuel tanks stated at 27157 470th Ave; Structural Welder - Evening Shift posted 2026-10-20 (updated 2026-11-15). Also builds power distribution centers (boundary). Record p-harvard-integrations-tea-sd.

verdicts.name: Lectrus, Houston TX and Chattanooga TN
verdicts.reason: Lectrus is now part of nVent (lectrus.com redirects to nvent.com/avail); its Chattanooga (1919 W Polymer Dr) and Houston (6100 Romona Blvd) sites are listed under nVent TRACHTE, whose pages show only substation control buildings, e-houses and modular data centers. The sole genset-enclosure evidence is a 2010 article. Excluded under rule 3: p-nvent-trachte-chattanooga-tn, p-nvent-trachte-houston-tx. The Tea SD Lectrus site is the Harvard Integrations record (#15) - unverified link, not asserted.

verdicts.name: Coastline Power Solutions, Longwood FL
verdicts.reason: coastlinepowersolutions.com lists only 1965 Bennett Drive, DeLand, FL 32724; the DeLand chamber of commerce profile mentions "Longwood" only in marketing prose and gives DeLand as its address. No Longwood street address or second facility found.

verdicts.name: nVent TRACHTE, Wisconsin
verdicts.reason: Oregon WI (479 N Burr Oak weld shop; 422 N Burr Oak office; 350 Braun Rd second site) is substation control buildings and e-houses: rule 3, lead for v-datacenter-grid-prefab. Record p-nvent-trachte-oregon-wi (excluded). Other nVent TRACHTE sites (Millington MD, Pittsburg KS, others) are not recorded here; Pittsburg KS already exists as p-atkinson-pittsburg-ks.
